# Environment variable reference

<!-- Generated by python -m tools.generate_env_reference; do not edit. -->

Defaults describe an unset environment. The declaration is the public getter contract. Effective defaults include per-engine policy and the defaults of legacy direct consumers. Automatic conditions name the policy or consumer that makes the decision. An enabled option still needs its kernel's dtype, layout and native-operator checks. Runtime routing depends on those checks.

Categories distinguish configuration, tuning, experimental, debug and deprecated controls. Prefer engine configuration and `VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS` for migrated acceleration paths.

| Variable | Category | Description | Declared default | Effective default | Automatic conditions / legacy consumer defaults | Acceleration paths |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `CUDA_HOME` | configuration | path to cudatoolkit home directory, under which should be bin, include, and lib directories. | None | None | None | No SM70 path association |
| `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` | configuration | used to control the visible devices in the distributed setting | None | None | None | No SM70 path association |
| `K_SCALE_CONSTANT` | configuration | Divisor for dynamic key scale factor calculation for FP8 KV Cache | 200 | 200 | None | No SM70 path association |

| `VLLM_ALLOW_CHUNKED_LOCAL_ATTN_WITH_HYBRID_KV_CACHE` | configuration | Allow chunked local attention with hybrid kv cache manager. | `VLLM_DEEP_GEMM_WARMUP` | configuration | DeepGemm JITs the kernels on-demand. The warmup attempts to make DeepGemm JIT all the required kernels before model execution so there is no JIT'ing in the hot-path. However, this warmup increases the engine startup time by a couple of minutes. Available options: - "skip"  : Skip warmup. - "full"  : Warmup deepgemm by running all possible gemm shapes the engine could encounter. - "relax" : Select gemm shapes to run based on some heuristics. The heuristic aims to have the same effect as running all possible gemm shapes, but provides no guarantees. | 'relax' | 'relax' | None | No SM70 path association |
